name: t0/greedy (matches off arm)
why: Not tuned by hardtemp.py, and deliberately so: that tuner exists to escape a non-terminating reasoning trace, and this model has no thinking mode to spiral. Its reasoning arm is the prompted-CoT arm, which changes the prompt and nothing else. Greedy is chosen because it is exactly what the off arm used, so the CoT arm isolates a single variable -- the instruction to reason before answering -- rather than moving prompt and sampling together. Note this model is prompted through /v1/completions with DeepSeek's documented turn format because its chat template is broken in this build (see patch_rawchat.py), and that the raw path is the one place where prompt wording has been measured to matter enormously here: a single trailing space moved its b3 score from 167/600 to 112/600. The CoT suffix is a much larger prompt change than a trailing space, so its result should be read as 'this model with this prompt', not as a clean reasoning delta.
